SPIRELAB-WITCH_FATE_SELECTED: Selected: {Card}. Confirm to add it to this combat.
SPIRELAB-WITCH_FATE_EMPTY: No matching cards. Change or reset the filters.
SPIRELAB-WITCH_ENLIGHTENMENT: Arcane Insight: choose 1 card to swap with a random card from your draw or discard pile
SPIRELAB-WITCH_PACT_ECHO: Return a non-Exhaust card from your discard pile
SPIRELAB-WITCH_OPENING_CHOICE: Fate Selection: choose 1 card to add to your draw pile for this combat
SPIRELAB-WITCH_GREED_KEEP: Mirror Desire: choose up to 1 other card to keep in hand
SPIRELAB-WITCH_SLOTH_RETAIN: Mirror Desire: choose up to 1 other card to Retain this turn
SPIRELAB-WITCH_FATE_DRAW: Choose 1 card from your draw pile to put into your hand
SPIRELAB-WITCH_CONVERT_BLOCK: Select to spend up to 4 Block for twice that amount next turn, or skip.
SPIRELAB-WITCH_OVERLOAD_ALL: Select to pay 1 extra Energy and hit all enemies, or skip to hit your target.
